Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Sharda - 65 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Nikhil stands in the snow. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What lovely weather!"

[Snow starts to fall.]

Nikhil: "Exactly right."

[Nikhil slides down the snowy slope.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Nikhil stands by the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil gets into the car.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Nikhil gets on the bus.]

Nikhil (softly): "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Night

Anjali: "Nikhil, look over here."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Nikhil: "Careful!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Nikhil: "What a nice place."

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Nikhil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
